posts.zh:
dsh-remote-link 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。官方 Web UI 的安全远程接入：带认证的局域网/隧道网关，QR + HMAC 一次性配对、按设备吊销，mDNS 发现，附 fork_session 会话分叉工具。

posts.en:
dsh-remote-link is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Secure remote access for the official Web UI: authenticated LAN/tunnel gateway with QR + HMAC one-time pairing, per-device sessions and revocation, mDNS discovery, and a fork_session tool.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3a2eb81f14f2fab56473.html
